name: math-worksheet
description: Print arithmetic drills with an answer key in seconds. Pick a grade preset — adding and subtracting within 20, within 100 with or without carrying, times tables, division with remainders, 3-digit sums, 2-digit multiplication — or set your own operations and number ranges. Choose how many problems, horizontal or vertical (column) layout and fill-in-the-blank problems like □ + 5 = 12; change the set number for a fresh sheet, or keep the same number to print the same one again. Edit any problem and it stays when you regenerate. Export the worksheet with a name, time and score line, a matching answer key in red, and a CSV. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 几秒钟打印口算练习和答案。选年级题型（20 以内加减、100 以内进位/不进位加减、表内乘除、有余数的除法、三位数加减、两位数乘法等），或者自己设运算和数字范围。设题数、横式或竖式、挖空题（□ + 5 = 12）；换一个题组编号就是一套新题，编号不变就能重印同一套。可以改任何一道题，重新生成时保留。导出带姓名、用时、得分栏的练习卷，红色答案卷和 CSV。在本地运行，无需账号或 API 密钥。
